notes: Account background: mid-market SaaS (customer-facing product personalization + knowledge-based support). Previously used Hosted API for prototyping; wants Dedicated for cost predictability and VPC. POC objective: validate Dedicated throughput at ~120 reqs/sec (avg 0.8k tokens/req), p50 latency <150ms, p95 <450ms; cost per 1k tokens target <$0.10. Security: SOC2 in place, needs SSO/SAML, KMS integration, full audit logging, 13-month retention for logs for compliance. POC plan (agreed): 4-week Dedicated POC with staged canary rollout: week 1 internal traffic only; week 2 3% customer traffic (canary) routed to Dedicated variant A (FP16, quantized); week 3 ramp to 20% with fallback routing to Hosted API in case of errors or latency breach; week 4 full load tests + rollback rehearsals. Model strategy: will test model variants — Llama-based 13B quantized for cost vs 33B FP16 for quality; routing policies to prefer region eu-west for EU traffic, us-east for NA, with automatic region failover to hosting region and a global fallback to Hosted API. Acceptance criteria: throughput, latency SLOs, model quality threshold on 200 eval prompts, and no security violations. Blockers noted: legal DPA clauses around subprocessors, network egress for EU region, hardware sizing for p95 spikes. Next steps: finalize SOW and Dedicated pricing+commit, schedule infra kick-off (network/VPC peering + KMS), assign CSM once POC begins. Quote from CISO: "We need proofs on audit trails and per-token retention before the pilot."
